description: Create an automation: a new account that distributes every balance it receives without a signature. Pass-through sends a share of each balance as-is to one address on the same chain; each output swaps and/or bridges its share to a token on a chain and sends it to an address. The pass-through percent plus the output percents must equal 100. Use --forwarder for a plain forwarding address. Requires an owner-scoped key.

forwarder.description: Forward 100% of every balance, as-is, to this address. Cannot be combined with the pass-through or output options.

minimumThresholdUsd.description: Smallest balance, in USD, that triggers a run. Defaults to 5, like the web app.

outputs.description: JSON array of outputs, each { percent, targetChainId, targetTokenAddress, destinationAddress }. Example: '[{"percent":100,"targetChainId":8453,"targetTokenAddress":"0x8335…","destinationAddress":"0x…"}]'

passThroughDestinationAddress.description: Address that receives the pass-through share. Required without --forwarder, even when the pass-through percent is 0; the web app uses the same address as the outputs.

passThroughPercent.description: Percent of each balance sent as-is to the pass-through destination. Defaults to 100 minus the output percents.

slippage.description: Maximum slippage for swaps and bridges, in basis points. Defaults to 150, like the web app.

workspace.description: Workspace alias to run this command in (see `splits auth workspaces`). Overrides SPLITS_WORKSPACE and the active workspace.

name: automations_create
